name: UCG-Fiber
title: Cloud Gateway Fiber
summary: Compact 10G Cloud Gateway: 5 Gbps IPS, 4x 2.5G LAN switch, NVMe NVR bay, runs all UniFi apps.

f.storage: 1x NVMe SSD slot (optional SSD, up to 2 TB)
requires: NVMe SSD for Protect recording (not in base SKU)

extra.poe_note: Tag feature:poe + 30W PoE Budget, but specs do not say which port(s) supply PoE or the class

gotchas: No-storage SKU has no NVMe SSD (and third-party SSDs need a tray accessory) — Protect can't record until you add one.
Only 30 W total PoE budget — enough for ~1 AP, not a PoE switch replacement; add a USW-Pro-Max-16-PoE / Ultra.
LAN switch ports are 2.5G; the 10G ports (1 RJ45 + 2 SFP+) default to WAN — 10G to a server/switch means reassigning one.
NVR capacity tops at 2 TB / ~5 4K cameras — bigger Protect deployments want a UNVR.
External 54V DC brick, no redundant power.
